Launch it
overview Gone are the days when this space was merely a disused, overlooked space.

At RomArte, we recognised the untapped potential of this venue and completely reimagined its interior. We developed a unique brand identity, crafted bespoke furniture, and meticulously selected a vibrant color palette and finishes to transform the atmosphere. While the visualisation you see simply serves as a reference to the space’s character, our work focused entirely on creating an immersive, contemporary dining experience through comprehensive interior design and thoughtful architectural details.

The work

We completely refreshed the look and feel of the space to bring it to the forefront of the current spirit, with a sleek, modern style.

Meticulously designed spatial experience for seamless comfort and aesthetic harmony.
From a technical standpoint, the advanced customization of spatial design enables a highly optimized user experience. We implemented tailored lighting systems, acoustic solutions, and modular architectural elements to ensure seamless functionality, comfort, and aesthetic coherence throughout the space.

And lastly, a comprehensive integration of smart lighting and acoustic systems enables KLU Pizza Club to enhance the guest experience by adapting ambiance in real time, while a bespoke spatial layout ensures optimal flow and interaction within the space.

KLU Pizza Club was born from a vision to create more than just a restaurant—it’s an experience. From the very beginning, we knew that every design choice, from lighting to bespoke art pieces, needed to come together seamlessly to craft an atmosphere that felt both contemporary and timeless.
Working with a team that truly understood our vision made all the difference. They took the time to dive deep into our concept, refining every detail to enhance not just aesthetics, but the way people interact with the space. The result is an environment that exceeds our expectations—where design, ambiance, and functionality merge effortlessly.
As with any great space, KLU continues to evolve, and we’re excited about the possibilities ahead. Seeing how guests engage with and appreciate the atmosphere confirms that the investment in thoughtful design was truly invaluable.

  • Marco Califano
  • Owner
